piece_type: HCP sales aid “CCA CVA Update Print 8.5x11” (MAT-PEM-00577-v2)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “82% DCR (95% CI, 74-89)” | “DCR was defined as CR+PR+SD” | “82.4% DCR (95% CI, 74-89)”
cases.context: Pages 8 and 10 (“FIGHT-202: ADDITIONAL ENDPOINTS”, “4-YEAR FOLLOW-UP ANALYSIS”); approval on ORR/DOR in single-arm FIGHT-202; disclaimers present. Complaints also received.
cases.rationale: SD/DCR not attributable to drug in single-arm trial; disclaimers do not cure.
cases.check: Rule: in single-arm-trial products, flag stable disease / DCR / waterfall plots including SD; disclaimers do not count as a fix.

cases.claim: “Median PFS=6.9 months (95% CI, 6.2-9.6)” | “Median OS = 21.1 months (95% CI, 14.8-NE)” | “Median PFS = 7.0 months (95% CI, 6.1-10.5)” | “Median OS = 17.5 months (95% CI, 14.4-22.9)”
cases.context: Kaplan-Meier graphs from single-arm FIGHT-202 incl. 4-year follow-up.
cases.rationale: PFS/OS from single-arm trial are uninterpretable.
cases.check: Rule: flag PFS/OS/survival/time-to-event claims (incl. cystectomy-free, DSS) when the source trial is single-arm; disclaimers do not count as a fix.
